claims.explanation: KF-38789 is annotated as a P-selectin inhibitor, but its transcriptional virtual cell profile closely resembles microtubule inhibitors (mebendazole, paclitaxel), indicating that its selective cytotoxicity is driven by anti-mitotic/tubulin activity. Sensitive lines are enriched for MAPK pathway activation (KRAS, BRAF, MAP2K1) and Wnt/APC-CTNNB1 mutations, while resistant lines frequently carry EGFR mutations or NF2 loss, suggesting these pathways modulate microtubule dependence and survival.
